summary: The document is a non-functional placeholder consisting of seven highly subjective, untestable statements regarding a food delivery mobile app. It lacks all standard software engineering artifacts, including scope, user roles, technical constraints, and acceptance criteria. It is completely unready for development, design, or testing.

risk_factors.title: Unquantifiable Performance Requirements
risk_factors.description: Requirement #3 states 'Delivery should happen fast' without defining latency, throughput, or SLA metrics. This makes it impossible to design the backend infrastructure or select appropriate cloud services.
risk_factors.mitigation: Define specific SLAs, e.g., 'API response time < 200ms for 95th percentile' and 'Order status update latency < 5 seconds'.

risk_factors.title: Undefined Payment Security and Compliance
risk_factors.description: Requirement #4 ('Customers can pay somehow') provides no guidance on PCI-DSS compliance, tokenization, or supported payment gateways. This creates a critical security and legal liability risk.
risk_factors.mitigation: Specify PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance, mandate the use of a certified third-party payment processor (e.g., Stripe, PayPal), and define data encryption standards (TLS 1.3) for transaction data.

risk_factors.title: Absence of Data Privacy Controls
risk_factors.description: The document does not mention GDPR, CCPA, or data retention policies. A food delivery app collects sensitive PII (address, phone, payment info), making this a severe regulatory risk.
risk_factors.mitigation: Add a section on Data Privacy detailing PII handling, consent mechanisms, data residency requirements, and user rights (right to be forgotten).

risk_factors.title: Undefined User Roles and Access Control
risk_factors.description: Requirement #5 ('Restaurants should manage things') is vague. Without defined roles (Customer, Restaurant Admin, Driver, Super Admin), it is impossible to implement Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
risk_factors.mitigation: Define a detailed User Role Matrix specifying permissions for each actor (e.g., Restaurant Admin can edit menu but not view other restaurants' sales).

conflicts_and_ambiguities.suggested_resolution: Replace with measurable UX metrics, such as 'Task completion rate for ordering > 90%' or 'App Store rating target > 4.5 stars'.
Define specific user flows: 'User can search by cuisine, filter by rating, and add items to cart in no more than 3 taps.'
Specify supported payment methods (Credit Card, Apple Pay, Wallet) and error handling procedures for failed transactions.
List specific management features: 'Manage menu availability, view daily sales reports, and update delivery zones.'

missing_sections_and_details.why_missing: Without scope, the project will suffer from scope creep. It is unclear if this includes driver app, restaurant web portal, or just customer mobile app.
missing_sections_and_details.recommended_addition: Define In-Scope (Customer iOS/Android App, Restaurant Web Dashboard) and Out-of-Scope (Driver App, Hardware Integration) items.

missing_sections_and_details.why_missing: The current statements are not functional requirements. Developers cannot code 'awesome' or 'easy'.
missing_sections_and_details.recommended_addition: Create detailed user stories with acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then format) for all core features: Registration, Browsing, Ordering, Payment, Tracking, and Reviews.

missing_sections_and_details.why_missing: No performance, availability, or scalability targets are defined. The system may fail under load.
missing_sections_and_details.recommended_addition: Specify: 'System must support 10,000 concurrent users', '99.9% uptime SLA', 'Auto-scaling for peak meal times'.

missing_sections_and_details.why_missing: No mention of authentication, authorization, encryption, or regulatory compliance (PCI, GDPR).
missing_sections_and_details.recommended_addition: Detail OAuth2.0/JWT authentication, AES-256 encryption for data at rest, TLS 1.3 for data in transit, and PCI-DSS compliance for payment processing.

missing_sections_and_details.why_missing: No information on how data flows between customer, restaurant, and delivery systems.
missing_sections_and_details.recommended_addition: Define API contracts (REST/GraphQL), database schema for core entities (User, Order, Menu, Payment), and third-party integrations (Maps, SMS, Payments).

ai_recommendations: Reject this document immediately. It is not a requirements specification but a list of vague wishes. Do not proceed to design or development based on this text.

Engage a Business Analyst to conduct stakeholder interviews to translate the vague statements into measurable, testable functional and non-functional requirements using the INVEST criteria (Independent, Negotiable, Valuable, Estimable, Small, Testable).

Mandate the inclusion of a Security and Compliance section that explicitly addresses PCI-DSS for payments and GDPR/CCPA for user data, as these are non-negotiable for a food delivery platform handling PII and financial transactions.
